125	      placeAltars(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, 1, CRIMSTONE);
126	    } else {
127	      // 腐化裂隙（cs:14368-14390）+ 丛林草→腐化丛林草（cs:14392-14404）
128	      let cooldown = 0;
129	      for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
130	        if (cooldown > 0) cooldown--;
131	        if (x === cx || cooldown === 0) {
132	          let sy = -1;
133	          for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
134	            if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] > 0) {
135	              sy = y;
136	              if (x === cx) {
137	                cooldown = 20;
138	                chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 149) + 150, true);  // Next(150)+150
139	              } else if (rng.int(0, 34) === 0 && cooldown === 0) {
140	                cooldown = 30;
141	                chasmRunner(st, rng, gs, x, y, rng.int(0, 49) + 50, true);    // Next(50)+50
142	              }
143	              break;
144	            }
145	          }
146	          void sy;
147	        }
148	        for (let y = gs.worldSurfaceLow; y < gs.worldSurface - 1; y++) {
149	          if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) continue;
150	          const depth = y + rng.int(10, 13);
151	          for (let y2 = y; y2 < depth; y2++) {
152	            if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y2)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] === JUNGLE_GRASS
153	              && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x < zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
154	              st.type[st.idx(x, y2)] = CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS;  // 60→661
155	            }
156	          }
157	          break;
158	        }
159	      }
160	      convertSurface(st, rng, gs, zLo, zHi, false);
161	      // 暗影球周黑檀石囊（cs:14546-14581，★仅本组区间；第二条件仅清 active 保 type 幽灵）
162	      cleanOrbPockets(st, rng, zLo, zHi);
163	    }
164	  }
165	  // CrimPlaceHearts（cs:14331）：全组结束后一次性（曾逐组内联 → 流序错位）
166	  if (gs.crimson) {
167	    crimPlaceHearts(st, rng, hearts);
168	  }
169	}
170	
171	/** ★独立 pass "Demon And Crimson Altars"（cs:15825-15885，注册序 LivingTreeWalls(15792)
172	 *  < 本 pass < SurfaceWaterInJungle(15887)）——与上方 runCorruptionPass 内的 placeAltars
173	 *  （cs:14241，Corruption pass 猩红分支**逐组**祭坛）是原版两处不同的放置，勿再合并：
174	 *  本 pass 为全图随机撒 (int)(w*h*3.3E-06) 个（4200×1200 → 16），不读 evilZones，
175	 *  style = crimson?1:0；x∈[281, w-283) 避开中央 45%-55% 带，y∈[⌊ws*2+rock⌋/3,
176	 *  ⌊rock+(h-350)*2⌋/3)（两界均先 cast 再整除 3）；落点拒绝采样 = oceanDepths(:10978)
177	 *  ∨ 距微光心 < 150(shimmerSafetyDistance :4104) ∨ dualDungeons 界内（秘种子门，
178	 *  普通世界恒 false）。每坛重试 ≤10000，IsTileNearby(26,3) 无邻坛才 Place3x2，成坛即停。
179	 *  微光避让门：本管线微光 pass(cs:15256) 仍整体排在 vanillaBiomes 之后（顺序偏差另案），
180	 *  此处 gs.shimmerX<0 时按"未生成"跳过该门——微光 pass 归位后此门自动生效。
181	 *  原版 pass 头部 Main.tileSolid[484]=false(:15830) 对本 pass 无影响：place3x2 的
182	 *  BOULDERS 门（含 484 滚仙人掌）已等价拒绝该类底座。 */
183	export function runAltarsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
184	  const count = Math.trunc(st.w * st.h * 3.3e-06);   // remixWorldGen×3 / dualDungeons÷2 秘种子门不适用
185	  const style = gs.crimson ? 1 : 0;
186	  const yLo = Math.trunc(gs.worldSurface * 2 + gs.rockLevel) / 3 | 0;   // (int)(ws*2+rock)/3
187	  const yHi = Math.trunc(gs.rockLevel + (st.h - 350) * 2) / 3 | 0;      // (int)(rock+(h-350)*2)/3
188	  const midLo = st.w * 0.45, midHi = st.w * 0.55;
189	  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
190	    for (let j = 0; j < 10000; j++) {
191	      let x = rng.int(281, st.w - 284);                              // Next(281, w-3-280)
192	      while (x > midLo && x < midHi) x = rng.int(281, st.w - 284);    // 避中央带（重掷仅 x）
193	      let y = rng.int(yLo, yHi - 1);                                 // Next(yLo, yHi)
194	      // 拒绝采样（cs:15847-15865）：两点全重掷（x 先过中央带门再掷 y）
195	      while (oceanDepths(st, gs, x, y)
196	        || (gs.shimmerX >= 0 && Math.hypot(x - gs.shimmerX, y - gs.shimmerY) < SHIMMER_SAFETY)) {
197	        x = rng.int(281, st.w - 284);
198	        while (x > midLo && x < midHi) x = rng.int(281, st.w - 284);
199	        y = rng.int(yLo, yHi - 1);
200	      }
201	      if (!isTileNearby(st, x, y, ALTAR, 3)) place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, style);
202	      if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) break;                    // 成坛即停（:15877）
203	    }
204	  }
205	}
206	
207	/** 地表转换带（cs:14131-14199 猩红 / cs:14406-14484 腐化）1:1。
208	 *  每格两道 Next(2) 边缘抖动门（内圈免骰）；53/1 的 ±Next(5) 门按类型各自独掷；
209	 *  首个活性格 SpreadGrass：0→199/23（递归）与 59→662/661（递归）双分支。 */
210	function convertSurface(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, crimson: boolean): void {
211	  let bandY = gs.worldSurface + 40;
212	  for (let x = zLo; x < zHi; x++) {
213	    bandY += rng.int(-2, 2);                                    // Next(-2,3)
214	    if (bandY < gs.worldSurface + 30) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 30;
215	    if (bandY > gs.worldSurface + 50) bandY = gs.worldSurface + 50;
216	    let first = false;
217	    const bandStart = gs.worldSurfaceLow;                       // (int)num
218	    for (let y = bandStart; y < bandY; y++) {
219	      // 边缘抖动门（cs:14145-14147）：x/y 内圈免骰，外圈 Next(2)!=0 才过
220	      if (!((x > zLo + 1 && x < zHi - 2) || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0)) continue;
221	      if (!((y > bandStart + 1 && y < bandY - 2) || rng.int(0, 1) !== 0)) continue;
222	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
223	      if (!st.flags[i]) continue;
224	      if (st.type[i] === T.SAND && x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x <= zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
225	        st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSAND : EBONSAND;             // 53→234/112
226	      }
227	      if (y < gs.worldSurface - 1 && !first) {
228	        if (st.type[i] === T.DIRT) {
229	          grassSpreadState.n = 0;
230	          // SpreadGrass(0→199/23)：原版 dirt=0（泥土）——内部侧传 T.DIRT（曾传 0=EMPTY，
231	          // type!==dirt 门全拒 → 邪恶草一格不铺）
232	          spreadGrassOnce(st, x, y, T.DIRT, crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS, true);
233	        } else if (st.type[i] === MUD) {
234	          grassSpreadState.n = 0;
235	          spreadGrassOnce(st, x, y, MUD, crimson ? CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS : CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS, true); // 59→662/661
236	        }
237	      }
238	      first = true;
239	      if (st.wall[i] === 216) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 218 : 217;
240	      else if (st.wall[i] === 187) st.wall[i] = crimson ? 221 : 220;
241	      if (st.type[i] === T.STONE) {
242	        if (x >= zLo + rng.int(0, 4) && x <= zHi - rng.int(0, 4)) {
243	          st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSTONE : EBONSTONE;         // 1→203/25
244	        }
245	      } else if (st.type[i] === T.GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_GRASS : CORRUPT_GRASS;
246	      else if (st.type[i] === JUNGLE_GRASS) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_JUNGLE_GRASS : CORRUPT_JUNGLE_GRASS;
247	      else if (st.type[i] === ICE) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_ICE : CORRUPT_ICE;       // 161→200/163
248	      else if (st.type[i] === SANDSTONE) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_SANDSTONE : CORRUPT_SANDSTONE;  // 396→401/400
249	      else if (st.type[i] === HARDSAND) st.type[i] = crimson ? CRIMSON_HARDSAND : CORRUPT_HARDSAND;      // 397→399/398
250	    }
251	  }
252	}
253	
254	/** 恶魔祭坛（cs:14201-14239）：10-14 个。拒绝采样 x∈[zLo-widen,zHi+widen)、
255	 *  y∈[ws-widen/2, ws+100+widen)；tries>100 先 widen++ 再找面/落点（原版顺序）；
256	 *  落点门 = widen>10 || 下方活性邪恶石，且 IsTileNearby(26,3) 无邻坛。 */
257	function placeAltars(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, zLo: number, zHi: number, style: number, stoneType: number): void {
258	  const count = rng.int(10, 14);                               // Next(10,15)
259	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
260	    let widen = 0, tries = 0, done = false;
261	    while (!done) {
262	      tries++;
263	      let x = rng.int(zLo - widen, zHi - 1 + widen);            // Next(zLo-widen, zHi+widen)
264	      let y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurface - widen / 2), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface + 100 + widen) - 1);
265	      // oceanDepths 重掷环（cs:14252-14256）：落点入海洋带则两点全重掷
266	      while (oceanDepths(st, gs, x, y)) {
267	        x = rng.int(zLo - widen, zHi - 1 + widen);
268	        y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurface - widen / 2), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface + 100 + widen) - 1);
269	      }
270	      if (tries > 100) { widen++; tries = 0; }                  // ★原版先 widen 后找面
271	      if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) {
272	        while (y < st.h - 1 && !st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) y++;
273	        y--;
274	      } else {
275	        while (y > 0 && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] && y > gs.worldSurface) y--;
276	      }
277	      if ((widen > 10 || (st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)] && st.type[st.idx(x, y + 1)] === stoneType))
278	        && !isTileNearby(st, x, y, ALTAR, 3)) {
279	        place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, style);
280	        if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) done = true;
281	      }
282	      if (widen > 100) done = true;
283	    }
284	  }
285	}
286	
287	/** oceanDepths（cs:10978-10989）：y 超过 oceanLevel 直接 false；横向上
288	 *  进沙滩带（beachDistance 内）返回 true。oceanLevel=(worldSurface+rockLayer)/2+40（cs:4393）。 */
289	function oceanDepths(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
290	  if (y > (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40) return false;
291	  return x < gs.beachDistance || x > st.w - gs.beachDistance;
292	}
293	
294	/** IsTileNearby（cs:8828）：★须 active（曾漏 → 幽灵坛误判邻坛） */
295	function isTileNearby(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, radius: number): boolean {
296	  for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {
297	    for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
298	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
299	      const i = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);
300	      if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === type) return true;
301	    }
302	  }
303	  return false;
304	}
305	
306	/** Place3x2（cs:52097）type=26 语义：界内 + 3×2 区域净空 + 三列底座实心（★active 实心，
307	 *  曾用 st.isSolid 不判 flags）+ 底座非巨石(523)。锚点=中下，帧 style*54+col*18。 */
308	function place3x2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): void {
309	  if (x < 5 || x > st.w - 5 || y < 5 || y > st.h - 5) return;
310	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
311	    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
312	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return;             // 区域须净空
313	    }
314	  }
315	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
316	    const bi = st.idx(x + dx, y + 1);
317	    if (!st.flags[bi]) return;                                  // SolidTile2 = active+tileSolid
318	    if (!TILE_DEFS[st.type[bi]]?.solid) return;
319	    if (BOULDERS.has(st.type[bi])) return;  // TileID.Sets.Boulders（TileID.cs:195：138/484/664/665/711-716）
320	  }
321	  for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
322	    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
323	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, type, style * 54 + (dx + 1) * 18, (dy + 1) * 18);
324	    }
325	  }
326	}
327	
328	/** 暗影之球(AddShadowOrb L16035):2×2,猩红 style 偏移 +36 */
329	function addShadowOrb(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, crimson: boolean): void {
330	  if (x < 10 || x > st.w - 10 || y < 10 || y > st.h - 10) return;
331	  for (let dx = -1; dx < 1; dx++) {
332	    for (let dy = -1; dy < 1; dy++) {
333	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] && st.type[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] === ORB) return;
334	    }
335	  }
336	  const fx = crimson ? 36 : 0;
337	  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y - 1, ORB, fx, 0);
338	  st.setTileSilent(x, y - 1, ORB, 18 + fx, 0);
339	  st.setTileSilent(x - 1, y, ORB, fx, 18);
340	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, ORB, 18 + fx, 18);
341	}
342	
343	/** ChasmRunner（cs:76066-76340）1:1：竖直裂隙。挖空/双壳全带 CanEvilReplace 门；
344	 *  壳1 = 激活+type=25（非坛才写 type），壳2 = type=25+激活+墙3（y>j+Next(3,20)）。
345	 *  球只放一次；第二裂隙尾部祭坛 = 纯随机点+IsTileNearby+Place3x2 重试 ≤10000。 */
346	function chasmRunner(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, steps: number, makeOrb: boolean): void {
347	  let sideways = false, orbPlaced = !makeOrb, altarPlaced = false;
348	  let num1 = steps + 0.0;
349	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
350	  let vx = rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.1;                             // Next(-10,11)
351	  let vy = rng.int(0, 10) * 0.2 + 0.5;                         // Next(11)*0.2+0.5
352	  let radius = rng.int(0, 4) + 7;                              // Next(5)+7
353	  const num3 = 5;
354	  while (radius > 0) {
355	    if (num1 > 0) {
356	      radius += rng.int(0, 2) - rng.int(0, 2);                // Next(3) 两次
357	      if (radius < 7) radius = 7;
358	      if (radius > 20) radius = 20;
359	      if (num1 === 1 && radius < 10) radius = 10;
360	    } else if (py > gs.worldSurface + 45) {
361	      radius -= rng.int(0, 3);                                 // Next(4)
362	    }
363	    if (py > gs.rockLevel && num1 > 0) num1 = 0;
364	    num1--;
365	    if (!sideways && py > gs.worldSurface + 20) {
366	      sideways = true;
367	      chasmRunnerSideways(st, rng, gs, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), -1, rng.int(20, 39));  // Next(20,40)
368	      chasmRunnerSideways(st, rng, gs, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), 1, rng.int(20, 39));
369	    }
370	    // 挖空（cs:76110-76119：num2>5 才挖；CanEvilReplace+非坛/魔矿/猩红矿三门）
371	    if (num1 > 5) {
372	      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(px - radius * 0.5)), x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 0.5));
373	      const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 0.5)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 0.5));
374	      for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
375	        for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
376	          const ti = st.idx(x, y);
377	          if (Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 0.5 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)
378	            && canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
379	            && st.type[ti] !== ORB && st.type[ti] !== DEMONITE && st.type[ti] !== CRIMTANE) {
380	            st.flags[ti] = 0;   // 只清 active（type 保留=幽灵）
381	          }
382	        }
383	      }
384	    }
385	    if (num1 <= 2 && py < gs.worldSurface + 45) num1 = 2;
386	    if (num1 <= 0) {
387	      if (!orbPlaced) {
388	        orbPlaced = true;
389	        addShadowOrb(st, Math.floor(px), Math.floor(py), false);
390	      } else if (!altarPlaced) {
391	        altarPlaced = false;   // ★原版 quirk（cs:76203 flag3=false 恒假）：深段每次迭代都重进本块
392	        // cs:76210-76240：纯随机点 → y>worldSurface 才试；IsTileNearby(26,3)+Place3x2，
393	        // 失败重试 ≤10000；y≤worldSurface 直接放弃。★无落点吸附（吸附是猩红散布专属）
394	        let tries = 0, done = false;
395	        while (!done) {
396	          let x = rng.int(Math.floor(px) - 25, Math.floor(px) + 24);   // Next(X-25, X+25)
397	          let y = rng.int(Math.floor(py) - 50, Math.floor(py) - 1);    // Next(Y-50, Y)
398	          x = Math.max(5, Math.min(st.w - 5, x));
399	          y = Math.max(5, Math.min(st.h - 5, y));
400	          if (y > gs.worldSurface) {
401	            if (!isTileNearby(st, x, y, ALTAR, 3)) place3x2(st, x, y, ALTAR, 0);
402	            if (st.type[st.idx(x, y)] === ALTAR) { done = true; continue; }
403	            if (++tries >= 10000) done = true;
404	          } else done = true;
405	        }
406	      }
407	    }
408	    px += vx; py += vy;
409	    vx += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.01;
410	    vx = Math.max(-0.3, Math.min(0.3, vx));
411	    // 壳1（cs:76282-76296）：CanEvilReplace + 激活/type=25
412	    const x0 = Math.max(1, Math.floor(px - radius * 1.1)), x1 = Math.min(st.w - 1, Math.floor(px + radius * 1.1));
413	    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(py - radius * 1.1)), y1 = Math.min(st.h, Math.floor(py + radius * 1.1));
414	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
415	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
416	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
417	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
418	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)) {
419	          if (st.type[ti] !== EBONSTONE && y > j + rng.int(3, 19)) st.flags[ti] = 1;  // Next(3,20)
420	          if (steps <= num3) st.flags[ti] = 1;
421	          if (st.type[ti] !== ORB) st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
422	        }
423	      }
424	    }
425	    // 壳2（cs:76309-76322）：type=25 + 激活 + 墙3
426	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
427	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
428	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
429	        if (canEvilReplace(st, x, y)
430	          && Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < radius * 1.1 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)) {
431	          if (st.type[ti] !== ORB) st.type[ti] = EBONSTONE;
432	          if (steps <= num3) st.flags[ti] = 1;
433	          if (y > j + rng.int(3, 19)) st.wall[ti] = 3;          // ebonStoneWall
434	        }
435	      }
436	    }
437	  }
438	}
439	
440	/** ChasmRunnerSideways（cs:75323-75523）1:1：水平裂隙。挖空三门同竖直版；
441	 *  壳 = 非31/22/204 才写 type、恒激活、墙2 清零；壳2 = 同门 + 墙3。
442	 *  末端 1/3 TileRunner 魔矿脉（Next(2,6)/Next(3,7), type 22）。 */
443	function chasmRunnerSideways(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number, direction: number, steps: number): void {
444	  let num1 = steps + 0.0;
445	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
446	  let vx = rng.int(10, 20) * 0.1 * direction;                  // Next(10,21)

678	/** CrimVein（cs:76035-76064）1:1：核心 0.2R 挖空(墙83)/壳 0.5R 猩红石(0.4R 墙)；

755	        }

761	    for (let x = hx - Math.floor(r2 / 2); x < hx + r2 / 2; x++) {
762	      for (let y = hy - Math.floor(r2 / 2); y < hy + r2 / 2; y++) {

105	    const y0 = Math.max(10, Math.min(st.h - 10, Math.floor(py - radius * 0.5)));
106	    const y1 = Math.max(10, Math.min(st.h - 10, Math.floor(py + radius * 0.5)));

158	function mudWallRunner(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, i: number, j: number): void {
159	  const { w, h } = st;
160	  const num = rng.int(8, 20) + 0.0;          // Next(8,21)（double）
161	  const num2 = rng.int(8, 32) + 0.0;         // Next(8,33)（double）
162	  let num3 = num2;
163	  let px = i + 0.0, py = j + 0.0;
164	  let vx = rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.1, vy = rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.1;
165	  while (num > 0 && num3 > 0) {

167	    num3 -= 1;
168	    let x0 = Math.trunc(px - num4 * 0.5), x1 = Math.trunc(px + num4 * 0.5);
169	    let y0 = Math.trunc(py - num4 * 0.5), y1 = Math.trunc(py + num4 * 0.5);
170	    if (x0 < 0) x0 = 0;
171	    if (x1 > w) x1 = w;
172	    if (y0 < 0) y0 = 0;
173	    if (y1 > h) y1 = h;
174	    for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
175	      for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
176	        if (Math.abs(x - px) + Math.abs(y - py) < num * 0.5 * (1 + rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.015)

178	          st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] = 0;
179	        }
180	      }
181	    }
182	    px += vx; py += vy;
183	    vx += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.05;
184	    if (vx > 1) vx = 1;
185	    if (vx < -1) vx = -1;
186	    vy += rng.int(-10, 10) * 0.05;
187	    if (vy > 1) vy = 1;
188	    if (vy < -1) vy = -1;

// 确定性随机数：Terraria 1.4.5.6 位级对齐。
//
// ── UnifiedRandom（Terraria.Utilities/UnifiedRandom.cs 1:1）─────────────────
// .NET System.Random 的 Knuth 减法生成器（MSEED=161803398），纯 int32 运算。
// 位级移植要点（JS/C# 数值差异全部钉死，改动前先读）：
//  1. C# int 溢出 unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS：本实现所有中间值都落在 int32 范围内
//     （diff 最小 -(2^31-1)，`+((n>>31)&0x7FFFFFFF)` 归位后 ∈[0,2^31-1]），
//     无需模拟回绕；存储用 Int32Array 与 C# int[] 同构。
//  2. `(int)double` 是向零截断 ↔ JS Math.trunc（Sample()≥0 时与 floor 等价，
//     但必须写 trunc 以防有人把 internalSample 改出负值）。
//  3. `Sample()` 常数 4.656612875245797E-10 = 1/(2^31-1)，十进制字面量两语言
//     解析为同一 double，乘法 IEEE754 位级一致。
//  4. `Next(min,max)` 的 range 用 long（≤2^32）↔ JS number 精确整数，安全。
//     大 range 分支的 `(int)(long+min)` unchecked 回绕 ↔ JS `|0`（ToInt32 mod 2^32）。
//  5. `GetSampleForLargeRange` 的 `% 2 == 0`：C# 余数带符号但只判零，JS `%` 同判。
//  金标：tests/golden/unified-random.json 由真·Terraria.exe 反射导出
//  （tools/golden/rand-golden.cs），tests/unified-random.test.ts 位级断言。
//
// ── 种子解析（WorldFileData.TranslateSeed, cs:399-410 1:1）────────────────
// 数字字符串 → Math.Abs(int)（int.MinValue→int.MaxValue）；非数字 →
// ReLogic.Utilities.Crc32.Calculate（IEEE 表，按 UTF-16 code unit 逐字符，
// 注意 `(crc ^ c) & 0xFF` 只取 char 低字节）。Crc32 结果可为负，直接作种子。
export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);
    this.setSeed(seed);
  }

  /** C# SetSeed（UnifiedRandom.cs:25-61）1:1 */
  setSeed(seed: number): void {
    this.seedArray.fill(0);
    // C#: (Seed == int.MinValue) ? int.MaxValue : Math.Abs(Seed)
    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.seedArray[55] = num2;
    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;
      num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0; // C# unchecked int：可能回绕，|0 = ToInt32 同语义
      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }
    for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
      for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
        this.seedArray[l] -= this.seedArray[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)];
        if (this.seedArray[l] < 0) this.seedArray[l] += 2147483647;
      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  /** C# Sample（:63-65）*/
  private sample(): number {
    return this.internalSample() * 4.656612875245797e-10;
  }

  /** C# InternalSample（:67-86）1:1。inext 为 uint 语义（0..55，无溢出面）*/
  private internalSample(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    let num3 = this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff); // >>31 算术移位，JS/C# 一致
    this.seedArray[num] = num3;
    this.inext = num;
    return num3;
  }

  /** C# GetSampleForLargeRange（:96-104）。注意两次 InternalSample 的求值顺序 */
  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }

246	      for (let iy = y0; iy <= y1; iy++) {

258	    noiseX += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01;
259	    noiseY += rng.int(-20, 20) * 0.01;
260	    noiseX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, noiseX));
261	    noiseY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, noiseY));
262	    x += (xDir + noiseX) * 0.6;
263	    y += (yDir + noiseY) * 0.6;
264	  }
265	  return [x, y];
266	}

443	function addLifeCrystal(st: TileStore, i: number, j: number): boolean {
444	  const { h } = st;

449	    const num = k - 1;

451	    if (!st.inBounds(i, num - 1) || !st.inBounds(i - 1, num - 1)

456	    if (st.liquid[at(i, num - 1)] > 0 && st.liquidType[at(i, num - 1)] === 4) return false;
457	    // cs:32092 EmptyTileCheck(i-1, i, num-1, num):心位 2×2 无活性块

460	        if (st.flags[at(xx, yy)]) return false;
461	      }
462	    }

464	    if (DUNGEON_WALLS.has(st.wall[at(i, num)])) return false;
465	    // cs:32104-32113:底座(i-1, num+1)/(i, num+1) 须 nactive(active 且非半砖)+tileSolid

467	      const bi = at(bx, num + 1);
468	      if (!st.flags[bi] || st.half[bi] || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[bi]]?.solid) return false;
469	      if (st.half[bi] !== 0 || st.slope[bi] !== 0) { st.half[bi] = 0; st.slope[bi] = 0; }  // 坡面复位
470	    }
471	    // cs:32124-32139:四格心,frameX 0/18、frameY 0/18
472	    st.setTileSilent(i - 1, num - 1, HEART, 0, 0);
473	    st.setTileSilent(i, num - 1, HEART, 18, 0);
474	    st.setTileSilent(i - 1, num, HEART, 0, 18);
475	    st.setTileSilent(i, num, HEART, 18, 18);
476	    return true;
477	  }
478	  return false;

544	  chests: Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>,
545	): void {

548	    const cand = gs.pyramidSpots[idx];
549	    const num = cand.x;
550	    if (num <= 300 || num >= st.w - 300) continue;
551	    // 地牢侧回避（cs:15450-15452）：dungeonSide>Left 时须 num ≥ dungeonX+0.15w；
552	    // dungeonSide<Right 时须 num ≤ dungeonX-0.15w（任一不过即拒）。

554	    //   非 Reset 期 dungeonLocation（2026-08-12 金字塔 handoff 疑点核实修复）
555	    const dgX = gs.generatingDungeonPositionX || gs.dungeonLocation;
556	    const band = st.w * 0.15;
557	    if (!(gs.dungeonSide > -1 || !(num < dgX + band))) continue;
558	    if (!(gs.dungeonSide < 1 || !(num > dgX - band))) continue;
559	    let k = cand.y;
560	    while (k < st.h && st.inBounds(num, k) && !st.flags[st.idx(num, k)]) k++;
561	    if (k >= gs.worldSurface) continue;
562	    if (st.type[st.idx(num, k)] !== SAND) continue;   // cs:15455 沙列门禁
563	    // 与全部先序候选（PyrX[0..idx-1]）取最小距，须 ≥220（cs:15460-15472）
564	    let minDist = st.w;
565	    for (let l = 0; l < idx; l++) minDist = Math.min(minDist, Math.abs(num - gs.pyramidSpots[l].x));
566	    if (minDist >= 220) {
567	      k--;
568	      pyramid(st, rng, gs, chests, num, k, 75, 125, false);
569	      accepted.push({ x: num, y: k });
570	    }
571	  }
572	}

768	  if (pileSize !== 1) return;

770	    && !!TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(xx, yy)]]?.solid;
771	  if (!solidAt(x, y + 1) || !solidAt(x + 1, y + 1)) return;
772	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return;

774	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 36, 18);

858	function placeAlch(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
859	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || !st.inBounds(x, y + 1)) return false;
860	  const k = st.idx(x, y);
861	  const g = st.idx(x, y + 1);

874	/** PlantAlch（cs:45910）1:1：y 带三段掷（1/40 深层带、9/10 地表带、其余全域），

876	function plantAlch(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
877	  const w = st.w, h = st.h;
878	  const num = rng.int(20, w - 21);                        // Next(20, maxTilesX-20)
879	  let y: number;
880	  if (rng.int(0, 39) === 0) y = rng.int(Math.floor((gs.rockLevel + h) / 2), h - 21);
881	  else if (rng.int(0, 9) !== 0) y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurface), h - 21);
882	  else y = rng.int(20, h - 21);
883	  while (y < h - 20 && !(st.inBounds(num, y) && st.flags[st.idx(num, y)])) y++;
884	  if (!st.inBounds(num, y)) return;
885	  const k = st.idx(num, y);
886	  if (!st.flags[k] || st.half[k] || st.slope[k] !== 0) return;   // nactive
887	  if (!st.inBounds(num, y - 1)) return;
888	  if (st.flags[st.idx(num, y - 1)] || st.liquid[st.idx(num, y - 1)] !== 0) return;
889	  const rad = Math.floor(15 * (w / 4200));
890	  const x0 = Math.max(4, Math.min(w - 4, num - rad));
891	  const x1 = Math.max(4, Math.min(w - 4, num + rad));
892	  const y0 = Math.max(4, Math.min(h - 4, y - rad));
893	  const y1 = Math.max(4, Math.min(h - 4, y + rad));
894	  let near = 0;
895	  for (let i = x0; i <= x1; i++) {
896	    for (let j = y0; j <= y1; j++) {
897	      if (TILE_ALCH.has(st.type[st.idx(i, j)])) near++;
898	    }
899	  }
900	  if (near < 5) {
901	    for (const [set, style] of HERB_STYLE_GROUND) {
902	      if (set.has(st.type[k])) placeAlch(st, num, y - 1, style);
903	    }
904	  }
905	}

348	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：
349	 *  自 j 向下扫至 k < maxTilesY-10，逐行检查 anyShimmer / 幼虫 231 → 整体失败；
350	 *  首个 SolidTile（半砖/坡面不算，WorldGen.SolidTile）落定。
351	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败。
352	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */
353	export function placeBuriedChest(
354	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
355	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean } = {},
356	): boolean {
357	  // ±2 内不得有滚石/祭坛（cs:35957-35966：InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders || 26 || 237）
358	  for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
359	    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
360	      const xx = i + dx, yy = j + dy;
361	      if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
362	      const k = st.idx(xx, yy);
363	      if (!st.flags[k]) continue;
364	      const t = st.type[k];
365	      if (BOULDER_TILES.has(t) || t === ALTAR || t === TALTAR) return false;
366	    }
367	  }
368	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
369	  let gy = j;
370	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
371	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
372	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
373	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
374	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
375	    if (solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) {
376	      // trySlope 门（cs:35951-35968）：style 17 时 ±30 盒内不得有箱/越界；
377	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）
378	      if (opts.trySlope && opts.style === 17) {
379	        for (let l = i - 30; l <= i + 30; l++) {
380	          for (let m = gy - 30; m <= gy + 30; m++) {
381	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)
382	            const nk = st.idx(l, m);
383	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
384	          }
385	        }
386	      }
387	      if (opts.trySlope) {
388	        if (st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] >= 1 && st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] <= 2) {
389	          slopeL = st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)];
390	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
391	        }
392	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {
393	          slopeR = st.slope[k];
394	          st.slope[k] = 0;
395	        }
396	      }
397	      break;
398	    }
399	  }
400	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;
401	  if (!solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) return false;
402	  // trySlope 失败回填（cs:37567-37575：仅压平过的格才恢复）
403	  const restoreSlopes = (): void => {
404	    if (slopeL > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = slopeL;
405	    if (slopeR > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i, gy)] = slopeR;
406	  };
407	
408	  let tile = opts.tile ?? CHEST;
409	  let style = opts.style;
410	  const flags: ChestFlags = { ...(opts.flags ?? {}) };
411	  let mainId = 0;
412	  let mainKey: string | null = null;
413	  if (typeof opts.loot === 'string') {
414	    mainKey = opts.loot;
415	    mainId = vanillaIdOfKey(opts.loot) ?? 0;
416	    if (mainId === 0 && ITEM_BY_KEY[opts.loot] === undefined) mainKey = null; // 无效键丢弃
417	  } else if (opts.loot !== undefined) {
418	    mainId = opts.loot;
419	  }
420	  if (style === undefined) {
421	    if (gy > st.h - 205) {
422	      // 地狱箱:style 4 + 地狱武器序(cs:36158-36171)
423	      style = 4;
424	      flags.hell = true;
425	      if (!mainId) mainId = nextHellItem(gs);
426	    } else {
427	      style = gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 ? 1 : 0;
428	      if (style === 0) flags.wooden = true;
429	    }
430	  }
431	  // ---- 冰箱门（cs:36107-36130 1:1）：三析取——(tile21&&style11) ||
432	  // (tile467&&style24) || (无主件 && 位置 && 脚下冰系)。★原版显式传 style 11
433	  // 也进本池（HouseBuilder 冰屋正是此路径）——旧实现 style===undefined 单门漏此
434	  const tBelow = st.type[st.idx(i, gy)];
435	  if ((tile === CHEST && style === 11) || (tile === CHEST2 && style === 24)
436	    || (!mainId && gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 && gy <= st.h - 205
437	      && (tBelow === SNOW || tBelow === ICE || tBelow === THIN_ICE))) {
438	    flags.ice = true;
439	    if (!mainId) {
440	      mainId = [670, 724, 950, 1319, 987, 1579][rng.int(0, 5)]; // cs:36121-36125
441	      if (rng.int(0, 19) === 0) mainId = 997; // 1/20 提炼机
442	      if (rng.int(0, 49) === 0) mainId = 669; // 1/50 鱼
443	    }
444	  }
445	  // ---- 沙漠箱门（cs:36066-36091 1:1）：三析取——(tile467&&style10) ||
446	  // (tile21&&style42&&flag16) || (无主件 && ≤h-205 && IsUndergroundDesert)
447	  const ud = gs.undergroundDesert;
448	  const inUd = !mainId && ud && i >= ud.x0 && i <= ud.x1 && gy >= ud.y0 && gy <= ud.y1 && gy <= st.h - 205;
449	  if ((tile === CHEST2 && style === 10) || inUd) {
450	    tile = CHEST2;
451	    style = 10;
452	    flags.desert = true;
453	    // cs:36084：分位点用蜂巢**实际雕刻范围**（desertHiveHigh/Low，PlaceClustersArea
454	    // 逐点收缩），非静态矩形 ±10（曾用 ud.y0/y1 → 分层界偏移）
455	    const deep = gy > (gs.desertHiveHigh * 3 + gs.desertHiveLow * 4) / 7;
456	    if (!mainId) {
457	      mainId = deep
458	        ? [4061, 4062, 4276][rng.int(0, 2)]
459	        : [4056, 4055, 4262, 4263][rng.int(0, 3)];
460	    }
461	  }
462	
463	  // 2×2 放置:顶行 frameY=0、frameX = style*36 + dx*18(PlaceChestDirect 语义)
464	  const topY = gy - 2;
465	  if (topY < 1) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
466	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
467	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
468	      if (!st.inBounds(i + dx, topY + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(i + dx, topY + dy)]) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
469	    }
470	  }
471	  // 样式派生 flag 族（cs:36201-36229）：32 蘑菇 / 16 神庙 / 13 天空主题
472	  if (style === 32) flags.mushroom = true;
473	  if (style === 16) flags.temple = true;
474	  if (style === 13) flags.skyTheme = true;
475	  if (!st.inBounds(i + 1, gy) || !st.flags[st.idx(i + 1, gy)]
476	    || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(i + 1, gy)]]?.solid) { restoreSlopes(); return false; }
477	  const fw = TILE_DEFS[tile].vanilla?.fw ?? 2;
478	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
479	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
480	      st.setTileSilent(i + dx, topY + dy, tile, style * fw * 18 + dx * 18, dy * 18);
481	    }
482	  }
483	  // 战利品:四深度分支完整表(此前仅主件+火把/药水,体感稀缺主因之一)
484	  const items = rollChestLoot({ rng, gs, gy, flags, mainKey, worldH: st.h }, mainId);
485	  chests.push({ x: i, y: topY, items });
486	  if (flags.hell) gs.hellChestIdx++; // cs:36257-36264 放置成功才前进（失败重试取同一件）
487	  return true;
488	}

490	/** Buried Chests pass:L7907 洞穴段(CaveChestCount 35-40 × WorldArea/5040000)。
491	 *  ★地狱段拆出 runUnderworldChestsPass:本函数曾在 hellPass 之前执行,
492	 *  地狱箱被后续地狱地形重写 100% 抹除(实际 0 个) */
493	export function runBuriedChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
494	  const { w, h } = st;
495	  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurfaceHigh + 20 + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
496	  // 洞穴箱:35-40 × 面积缩放(Configuration.json CaveChestCount ScaleWith:WorldArea;
497	  // 小世界(4200×1200=5040000)= 1.0 → 35-40;中 ×2.29;大 ×4.0)
498	  const target = Math.round(rng.int(35, 40) * (w * h) / 5040000);
499	  let fail = 10000;
500	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
501	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
502	    const y = rng.int(yMin, h - 231);
503	    const wl = st.inBounds(x, y) ? st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] : -1;
504	    // cs:17109：wallDungeon[wall] || wall == 87（神庙墙 87 独立门）→ 整体重掷
505	    if (isDungeonWall(wl) || wl === 87 || !placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
506	      fail--; continue;
507	    }
508	    n++;
509	  }
510	}

512	/** 地狱箱(UnderworldChestCount 10-15 × WorldWidth/4200)。
513	 *  必须在 hellPass + 地狱屋之后调用(原版 Underworld(cs:13697) < Buried Chests(cs:17066)) */
514	export function runUnderworldChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
515	  const { w, h } = st;
516	  const target = Math.round(rng.int(10, 15) * (w / 4200));
517	  let fail = 10000;
518	  for (let n = 0; n < target && fail > 0; ) {
519	    const x = rng.int(20, w - 21);
520	    const y = rng.int(h - 200, h - 51);
521	    if (!placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y)) {
522	      fail--; continue;
523	    }
524	    n++;
525	  }
526	}

528	/** Surface Chests pass(L8019):w*0.005 个地表木箱(style 0;墙 244 → 天空箱 style 12) */
529	export function runSurfaceChestsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
530	  const { w } = st;
531	  const count = Math.floor(w * 0.005);
532	  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
533	    let ok = false;
534	    for (let tries = 0; tries < 2000 && !ok; tries++) {
535	      // cs:17244 首掷 Next(200, w-200);仅落点命中 oceanDepths(cs:17246-17254:
536	      // y ≤ oceanLevel=(ws+rl)/2+40 且 x 在海滩带内)才改掷 Next(300, w-300)——
537	      // 原版 WorldGen.beachDistance 是常量 380(cs:4102)
538	      let x = rng.int(200, w - 201);
539	      let y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
540	      const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
541	      while (y <= oceanLevel && (x < gs.beachDistance || x > w - gs.beachDistance)) {
542	        x = rng.int(300, w - 301);
543	        y = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow), Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) - 1);
544	      }
545	      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
546	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
547	      // cs:17260-17284 两分支：空格走墙门（2/59/244，墙 244 → 天空箱）；
548	      // 落点活性格走 101×101（步 2）蓄水池采样找墙 244 空格（Next(num8) 命中即换点）
549	      let sky = false;
550	      let cx = x, cy = y;
551	      if (!st.flags[i]) {

The vanilla EnchantedSwordBiome.Place is quite different from the replica:

Vanilla gates (in order):
1. 50×50 TileScanner at (origin.X-25, origin.Y-25) counting tiles 0/1; if dirt+stone < 1250 → false.
2. origin.Y > 55 required.
3. Find Up(origin.Y-55) for a solid area (1 × min(50, origin.Y-55)) → result; if not found → false; result.Y += 50.
4. If any sand (53) in the up-search column → false.
5. num5 = 0.8 + NextDouble()*0.5 — 1 die.
6. structures.CanPlace checks (the replica has no StructureMap — documented deviation in MicroBiomesPass header but this file doesn't document).
7. Slime(20, num5, 1.0) + Blotches(2, 0.4) + ClearTile → shapeData.
8. Mound(14,14) at point2 (origin.Y+30) + Blotches(2, 1, 0.8) + SetTile(0) → shapeData2.
9. shapeData.Subtract(shapeData2).
10. InnerOutline(shapeData) → SetTile(2) (grass ring!).
11. All(shapeData) + RectangleMask(-40,40,0,40) + IsEmpty + SetLiquid (water).
12. All(shapeData) + PlaceWall(68) + OnlyTiles(2) + Offset(0,1) + ActionVines(3,5,382).
13. If NextDouble() <= _chanceOfEntrance → carve the 1-wide shaft (origin.Y-result.Y-9 tall) + Blotches(2,0.2) + SkipTiles(191,192) + Expand(1) + OnlyTiles(53) + SetTile(397).
14. If NextDouble() <= _chanceOfRealSword → PlaceTile(187 style 17) else PlaceTile(186 style 15).
15. Grass action on the mound top.

The replica:
- No 1250 dirt/stone gate; instead "inBounds && active" gate (self-made).
- No origin.Y > 55 gate; instead `sy >= worldSurface+30` (self-made).
- Sand check: vanilla checks sand in the column between result.Y and origin.Y (the up-search); replica checks the whole column above oy (0..oy) (different semantics — vanilla's is only up to 50-? tiles... actually num3 = origin.Y - 55, and Find Up(num3) — the whole column up to 55 above origin. Hmm, roughly similar but the replica scans from 0 to oy — much wider. Self-made.)
- Slime shape: replica uses an ellipse rx=20*num5, ry=20 with `rng.next() < 0.15` skip — vanilla uses Shapes.Slime(20, num5, 1.0) + Modifiers.Blotches(2, 0.4) which consumes dice differently (Blotches: 1 discarded NextDouble + chance check per cell + 4 Next per blotch...). The replica's per-cell single NextDouble < 0.15 is a completely different dice consumption.
- The cave is placed at `sy = oy - rng.int(10, 20)` — vanilla point = (origin.X, origin.Y + 20) — i.e., 20 BELOW origin, not above! And point2 = origin.Y + 30 (the mound). The replica puts the mound at sy-4 (above the cave) and the shaft from sy+5 up to worldSurface. Vanilla's geometry: the cave is BELOW the origin point (origin.Y+20), and the shaft goes UP from result.Y+10 (= up to 50 above origin, since result.Y = origin.Y-55+50 = origin.Y-5... hmm wait.

Let me recompute: origin.Y > 55; num3 = origin.Y - 55; num4 = min(50, num3); Find(origin, Up(num3), IsSolid().AreaOr(1, num4)) — searches up to num3 tiles up for a column of at least num4 solid tiles. result = the top of that column. result.Y += 50 → so the shaft top is ~50 below the found surface... Hmm, result.Y is the top of a solid column found going UP from origin; +50 pushes it back down 50. If the column of solid is ≥ num4 = min(50, origin.Y-55), the found top could be near the surface. Then rectangle2 = (origin.X, result.Y+10, 1, origin.Y-result.Y-9) — the shaft spans from result.Y+10 down to origin.Y+1. And the cave (Slime) is at point = (origin.X, origin.Y+20) — 20 below origin.

So vanilla: the sword shrine entrance is BELOW the surface by ~10-50 tiles, the shaft goes up from the entrance toward the surface, and the cave is 20-30 tiles below origin. The replica has it inverted-ish: the cave at oy - (10..20) (ABOVE the seed point), the mound above that, and the shaft from the cave up to the surface.

Given origin.Y = worldSurface + Next(50,100), vanilla's cave center = origin.Y + 20 = 50-120 below the surface. The replica's cave center = oy - 10..20 = 30-90 below the surface. Different geometry.

15	      const i = st.idx(x, y);
16	      st.flags[i] = 1;
17	      st.type[i] = T.GRASS;
18	    }
19	  };

21	    const x1 = rng.int(1, w - 2);
22	    let y1 = rng.int(gs.worldSurfaceLow, Math.max(gs.worldSurfaceLow, gs.worldSurfaceHigh - 1));
23	    if (y1 >= h) y1 = h - 2;
24	    seed(x1, y1);
25	    const x2 = rng.int(1, w - 2);

346	  private isTrackNearby(x: number, y: number, distance: number): boolean {
347	    if (this.trackCount === 0) return false;
348	    const x0 = x - distance, x1 = x + distance;
349	    const y0 = y - distance, y1 = y + distance;
350	    const gx0 = x0 >> 6, gx1 = x1 >> 6;
351	    const gy0 = y0 >> 6, gy1 = y1 >> 6;
352	    for (let gy = gy0; gy <= gy1; gy++) {

355	        if (!list) continue;

357	          const cx = cell >> 14, cy = cell & 0x3fff;
358	          if (cx >= x0 && cx <= x1 && cy >= y0 && cy <= y1) return true;
359	        }
360	      }
361	    }
362	    return false;
363	  }

68	export function canPoundTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
69	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
70	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
71	  if (!st.flags[i]) return false; // 同 solidTile：幽灵 tile 不可砸
72	  const t = st.type[i];
73	  if (t === 0) return false;
74	  if (POUND_BLACKLIST.has(t)) return false;
75	  if (BOULDERS.has(t)) return false;
76	  if (POUND_GEN_SKIP.has(t)) return false;
77	  // ④ 上格 ForbidsSloping（cs:81475-81478：上格 active 且禁坡物 → 不可砸）
78	  if (st.inBounds(x, y - 1)) {
79	    const up = st.idx(x, y - 1);
80	    if (st.flags[up] && FORBIDS_SLOPING.has(st.type[up])) return false;
81	  }
82	  const d = TILE_DEFS[t];
83	  // !framed ≈ CanKillTile 的框架物拦截（箱/罐/雕像等不可砸半砖）——CanKillTile 整体仍近似
84	  return !!d && d.solid && !d.platform && !d.framed;
85	}

112	/** Tile.SmoothSlope（1456 Tile.cs:822-880, applyToNeighbors=false 生成期路径,sync 段为联机略）：
113	 *  按四邻实心位形自整砖/半砖/坡面 1-4 推导。num 位序:上<<3 下<<2 左<<1 右。
114	 *  case10(上左)→slope3;case9(上右)→slope4;case6(下左)→slope1;case5(下右)→slope2;
115	 *  case4(仅下)→半砖;其余→整砖 */
116	function smoothSlope(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
117	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
118	  if (!canPoundTile(st, x, y) || !solidOrSlopedTile(st, x, y)) return;
119	  const flag = !tileEmpty(st, x, y - 1);                                  // 上方有物
120	  const flag2 = !solidOrSlopedTile(st, x, y - 1) && flag;                 // 上方非实心
121	  const flag3 = solidOrSlopedTile(st, x, y + 1);                          // 下方实心
122	  const flag4 = solidOrSlopedTile(st, x - 1, y);                          // 左实心
123	  const flag5 = solidOrSlopedTile(st, x + 1, y);                          // 右实心
124	  const num = ((flag ? 1 : 0) << 3) | ((flag3 ? 1 : 0) << 2) | ((flag4 ? 1 : 0) << 1) | (flag5 ? 1 : 0);
125	  switch (num) {
126	    case 10: if (!flag2) { st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 3; } break;
127	    case 9:  if (!flag2) { st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 4; } break;
128	    case 6:  st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 1; break;
129	    case 5:  st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 2; break;
130	    case 4:  st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 1; break;
131	    default: st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0; break;
132	  }
133	}

281	/** 原版 pass "Waterfalls"（WorldGen.cs:7697-7743）：水边唇缘砸半砖（瀑布触发的来源） */
282	export function runWaterfallLipPass(st: TileStore, _rng: RNG, _gs: GenState): void {
283	  const { w, h } = st;
284	  // —— 第一遍（L7701-7723）：实心顶格、左右空、侧旁有水 → 砸半砖 ——
285	  for (let i = 20; i < w - 20; i++) {
286	    for (let j = 20; j < h - 20; j++) {
287	      if (!solidTile(st, i, j)) continue;
288	      const li = st.idx(i - 1, j), ri = st.idx(i + 1, j);
289	      // cs:16709:左右邻须 !active(曾误用 type!==0 → 幽灵格侧邻漏砸半砖)
290	      if (st.flags[li] !== 0 || st.flags[ri] !== 0) continue;
291	      if (!solidTile(st, i, j + 1)) continue;
292	      if (st.liquid[li] === 0 && st.liquid[ri] === 0) continue;
293	      // 上方 8-20 格内已有半砖则跳过（原版防连续砸穿）
294	      let flag = true;

 *  容忍活跃格白名单（两分支同表）：{61,703,62,69,655,74} ∪ {185 且 frameY==0}；
 *  净空通过先 KillTile 白名单格再写块。地面 = 放置列正下方 nactive 整砖且
 *  type==60。inheritPaint 恒 no-op（生成期无漆）。返回是否成块（主循环
 *  失败回退用）。 */
function placeJunglePlant233(
  st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, styleX: number, styleY: number,
): boolean {
  const dxLo = -1, dxHi = styleY > 0 ? 0 : 1;   // 2×2 分支 x-1..x；3×2 分支 x-1..x+1
  const inB = (cx: number, cy: number) => st.inBounds(cx, cy);
  let ok = true;
  for (let dx = dxLo; dx <= dxHi; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (!inB(x + dx, y + dy)) { ok = false; continue; }
      const ni = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);
      if (st.flags[ni]) {
        const s = SHEET[st.type[ni]];
        const tolerated = s === 61 || s === 703 || s === 62 || s === 69 || s === 655 || s === 74
          || (s === 185 && st.frameY[ni] === 0);
        if (!tolerated) ok = false;
      }
    }
    const gx = x + dx;
    if (!inB(gx, y + 1) || !solidTile(st, gx, y + 1) || SHEET[st.type[st.idx(gx, y + 1)]] !== 60) {
      ok = false;
    }
  }
  if (!ok) return false;
  for (let dx = dxLo; dx <= dxHi; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (inB(x + dx, y + dy) && st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) {
        st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, 0, 0, 0);   // KillTile（active=false+type=0）
      }
    }
  }
  if (styleY > 0) {
    const fx0 = 36 * styleX;
    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 0; dx++) {
      for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
        if (!inB(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
        st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, JUNGLE_LARGE, fx0 + (dx + 1) * 18, 36 + (dy + 1) * 18);
      }
    }
  } else {
    const fx0 = 54 * styleX;
    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
      for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
        if (!inB(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
        st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, JUNGLE_LARGE, fx0 + (dx + 1) * 18, (dy + 1) * 18);
      }
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** JunglePlantsPart2 主体：w*100 次尝试。每次列 = Next(40, w/2-40)，地牢在左
 *  （dungeonSide<=-1 ≙ DungeonSide.Left=-1）则 +w/2 取另一半（丛林侧）；起始行
 *  Next(h-300) 向下扫到首格活跃；若为丛林草 60 → 行上移一格 PlaceJunglePlant
 *  （233, Next(8), 0），失败（落点非 233）回退 (233, Next(12), 1)。 */
export function runJunglePlantsPart2Pass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  const w = st.w;
  for (let i = 0; i < w * 100; i++) {
    let num = rng.int(40, Math.floor(w / 2) - 41);      // Next(40, w/2-40)
    if (gs.dungeonSide <= -1) num += Math.floor(w / 2);
    let j = rng.nextInt(st.h - 300);                    // Next(h-300)
    while (!st.flags[st.idx(num, j)] && j < st.h - 300) j++;
    const ji = st.idx(num, j);
    if (st.flags[ji] && SHEET[st.type[ji]] === 60) {
      j--;
      placeJunglePlant233(st, num, j, rng.int(0, 7), 0);            // Next(8)
      const ti = st.inBounds(num, j) ? st.idx(num, j) : -1;
      if (ti < 0 || !st.flags[ti] || SHEET[st.type[ti]] !== 233) {
        placeJunglePlant233(st, num, j, rng.int(0, 11), 1);         // Next(12)
      }
    }
  }
}

- 同函数还缺:`InWorld(i,j,10)` 门(cs:75215)、`j >= worldSurface && dirt==0` 门(cs:75225 — 对 dirt=0 的 SpreadingGrass 递归会爬到地表线以下)；岩浆处理写成硬 return(:26),原版是 `enclosed=true; 仅 break 内层`(`cs:75260-75264`,后续列可拉回)。**MushroomPass.spreadGrassOnce(:35-78) 已把这三条全部做对** — Spread.ts 是旧分叉，应对齐。
- 影响：**geometry**(草分布)，零掷骰。

**8. WorldGen.ts:1476 — 出生点扫描自制 solid 门(geometry+rng-stream)**
- 原版权威:`WorldGen.cs:19683` 仅 `active() && type != 379`。复刻额外加 `TILE_DEFS[type]?.solid`(注释自称"防树干致浮空出生，保留")。采样列首格是树干时两者选不同格 → 出生点偏移 + 重试骰数不同(其后的草墙/向日葵/栽树流全部平移)。已备案但确属自制强化。

**9. PilesPass.ts — 缺 pass 头 `tileSolid` 覆写块(geometry,低频)**
- 原版权威:`WorldGen.cs:18906-18916` 把 379/229/190/196/189/717-719/202/460/484 全部置非实心，pass 期间有效。复刻未建模，而仓库数据 `v_189/v_196` solid:true → `placePile3x2`(:81 只查 `TILE_DEFS?.solid`)会把堆锚在浮空岛云块上(段③ 采样域 y∈[10,worldSurface) 覆盖浮空岛)。另 placePile3x2 漏 slope/half 判定(AnchorBottom 要求整砖)。

**10. BuriedChestsPass.ts:498/516 + CaveHousePass.ts:642-645 — 四颗计数骰的流位与顺序(rng-stream)**
- 原版权威:`WorldGen.cs:17081-17084` 在 UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests pass 头**连续**掷 CaveHouseCount→UnderworldChestCount→CaveChestCount→AdditionalDesertHouseCount,然后才是洞穴箱→地狱箱→小屋→沙漠小屋。复刻：洞穴箱骰(结构槽)→小屋骰+沙漠骰(其后一格)→地狱箱骰(约 36 槽之后的"地狱箱"槽，备案为强制拆分)。骰值错位挂到不同计数上。

## Acceptable / 低危(备案成立或影响可忽略)

- **CorruptionPass.ts:272/:515/:663** — 三处首实心扫描的防御性界(`y<h-1`、`y<st.h`、`y<st.h-1`):原版对应(`cs:14262-14268`、`cs:75520-75522`、`cs:75833-75849`)均无界，但实际总会命中实心格，界只在原版会崩溃的不可达情形触发。**acceptable**。chasmRunner/crimStart/crimVein/crimEnt/Place3x2/祭坛 pass 逐掷核对全部一致。
- **BuriedChestsPass.ts:84 hellChestItems 兜底** — 确认管线内无影响:`vanillaTerrain`(pass 1)在 WorldGen.ts:379-385 按 `cs:11262-11274` 洗牌落 `gs.hellChestItems`,GenState 缺省 null 只在探针直调路径触发。**acceptable**。
- **FinalCleanupPass.ts:205 "原版无 active 门"** — 核实无影响：原版 `KillTile` 自身 `if (!tile.active()) return`(`cs:63578-63582`),复刻 killTile 的 !flags 早退等价。**acceptable**。⑦-⑫ 各段门禁/顺序逐一核对一致。
- **MicroBiomesPass.ts:916 巨石石壳跳过惰性格** — 备案成立：原版 `DeadMansChestBiome.cs:599-607` 对含幽灵在内全部格子写 type=1+致动位；差异仅是幽灵 type(finalize 会净化)与惰性格致动位。**cosmetic,acceptable**。
- **MicroBiomesPass.ts:76 DUNGEON_TILES** — 备案表**可证错**:`Main.tileDungeon = {41,43,44,677,678,679}`(Main.cs:7941-7946),复刻只列 {41,43,44,677}(还引错行号 7941-7944)。仅 placeLavaTrap:1091 消费，678/679 在熔岩陷阱深度几乎不存在。**acceptable(修表即可)**。
- **WorldGen.ts:258 finalize 后补扫** — 自制补偿 pass(备案"本仓补")，零掷骰；根因是本仓 KillTile 无整块语义。**cosmetic,acceptable**。
- **TrackPass.ts** — 头注三项近似之外未发现活跃自制机制；水盒/三段列扫/掷序/IsTileNearby 桶索引等价性、frameTrack 后置等价性均核实成立。**通过**。
- **GrassPass.ts / GrassWallPass.ts** — 逐掷、门禁、短路与 vanilla cs:12454-12530 / 19734-19824 一致。**通过**。
- **SurfaceDecorPasses.ts** — 头注三项近似之外，抽查 FallenLogs(30000/5000 预算与放宽)、Vines 六段+蜂巢凹龛(else-if 常规世界分支)、DyePlants、JunglePlantsPart2(含失败回退)均 1:1。**通过**。
- **StructuresPass.ts:541 金字塔** — 自掷兜底确已删，现版与 `cs:15439-15489` 一致(x 区间、地牢侧双析取、与全部先序候选距≥220、k--);`Pyramid()` 本体(`cs:27816-28160`)含 `cs:28078` 上界逐列重掷的怪癖都 1:1。仅 `dgX = generatingDungeonPositionX || dungeonLocation` 的 `||` 兜底是自制(管线内 DungeonPass 恒已赋值，不触发)。**acceptable**。

## Uncertain

- **MicroBiomesPass.ts:611-630 DeadMans 候选栅格扫描** — 已备案，但备案理由"候选集相同"不成立：每候选固定耗 4 颗骰，枚举序不同 → 骰值挂到不同箱上，而 `AreThereEnoughTraps` 依赖这些骰值 → 候选集会变。**uncertain**(已披露，但论据错误，流与选择都可能偏)。

## 顺带的文档过期(非机制)

- StructuresPass.ts:944-948 的"已知近似"清单已过期：绿洲消费段(cs:21129-21163)与尾部燕麦段(cs:21302-21320)**已实现**且与原版一致(1271-1293、1302-1309)。
- WorldGen.ts:1000-1001 墓园排斥表把 481-483 标作 "tileDungeon[] 全表"(应为 677-679);另墓碑 epitaph 用非流内随机(vanilla `RandomFromCategory("Epitaph", genRand)` 每碑耗 1 骰)、:1100 的 style 骰在自制净空检查之后才掷(vanilla 作 PlaceTile 实参先掷)→ 均为秘密种子专属路径，低危。
- CorruptionPass.ts 头注"微光 pass 归位后此门自动生效"——现状微光槽(管线 ：79)确在结构槽(:85)之前，`gs.shimmerX>=0` 门实际恒活，无问题。

## 总体结论

清单内最严重的活跃问题集中在**掷骰流对齐**：JunglePass 隧道分支洞穴缺全局 mudWall(少耗海量逐格骰)、剑冢整体近似+管线错位、营地 Blotches 少掷 + `Next()%N` 错译、瓦罐扫描漏 active 门、Waterfalls 漏 75/76 的 `Next(10)`。这五处任意一处都足以让种子等价(RNG 位级金标)在各自 pass 之后整体失效，且全部可低成本修复(mudWall 传参、谓词替换、加 flags 判定、补一行特判)。几何类自制(出生点 solid 门、Spread.ts 的 400 深度与缺失门禁、Piles 的 tileSolid 覆写、剑冢形状)不影响流但会改变可见地形。CorruptionPass、TrackPass、GrassPass/GrassWallPass、FinalCleanupPass 及 StructuresPass 金字塔段现状为 1:1,无活跃自制机制。
